reason: The supervisor is plain Node (it spawns the native runtime and speaks its framed stdio) and the command line needs the same one. It still lives under electron/ because tsconfig.electron.json compiles with rootDir electron, so electron/main.ts cannot import a module of src/. Moving it needs the shared Node modules (this one, nativeSimulationIpc, the protocol files) in a folder both programs compile, which is the layout decision of the IPC contract work (IDE-017); do it there and delete this entry.

The function that gives a native simulation its loopback communication environment is pure (no Electron or Node API beyond process.env) and the command line must build the environment of a scenario run the way Studio does. It lives under electron/ for the reason of the entry for nativeSimulationSupervisor.ts: tsconfig.electron.json compiles with rootDir electron, so electron/main.ts cannot import a module of src/. It moves with the shared modules of the IPC contract work (IDE-017); delete this entry then.

It lives under electron/ for the reason of the entry for nativeSimulationSupervisor.ts: tsconfig.electron.json compiles with rootDir electron, so electron/main.ts cannot import a module of src/, and a spawn list that the command line owned would leave the main process without it. Moving it needs the shared Node modules in a folder both programs compile, a change to the packaged layout of electron-dist that is not made here; do it with the move of the supervisor and delete these entries.
